text: E a yi'aali an Nulaaɗo, ko hono Alla piyiri misal konngol tawhiidi ngol: Reweteeɗo tanaa Allaahu alaa, Tuma O nanndani ngol e leggal welngal, woni duɓɓehi (tamoroowi) binndeere maggal on no irii ka leydi hino yarira ndiyam calɗi maggal laaɓuɗi, calɗi maggal on no toowita ka weeyo, no yara caawa, foofa henndu laaɓundu.
